# Weapon and ability projectile radii

Source: [Projectile size of all weapons and abilities](../archive/8242.md); page edited 2026-02-27.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/8242.md#wiki-8242) before using these values.

Values are radii in metres, not diameters. The cited upstream forum post uses diameter.

Includes hitscan/beam entries and differing ally/enemy and charged/unscoped cases. Names and balance values are patch-sensitive.

Source-reported verification code: 7QW6W; credited contributor: SchWiniX.
